title: Talitha Mahome
description: Chippewa Valley Schools Board of Education Trustee.
body:
Believes that schools [should have](https://web.archive.org/web/20260610024910/https:/www.michiganedjustice.org/school-board-candidates-2024/mahome,-talitha---chippewa-valley-schools) “regular mental health screenings” and should increase mental health professionals in schools.

## Race-based views

- Claims schools [must address](https://web.archive.org/web/20260610024910/https:/www.michiganedjustice.org/school-board-candidates-2024/mahome,-talitha---chippewa-valley-schools) “systemic barriers” for black students.

- Advocates for “offering diversity and inclusion training for staff.”

- When asked about her thoughts on recruiting and retaining staff of color, she said, “we should be prioritizing diversity in recruitment.”

Proudly endorsed by a gun control group.
